unit.why: An anecdote told by R. Yaakov of Nesukhoyzh about seeing R. Barukh of Medzhybizh at the Yom Kippur eve meal: his melodies, two tears, and his punning blessings over the fish and the soup.

stories.summary_en: R. Yaakov of Nesukhoyzh recounts that R. Barukh of Medzhybizh was always joyful, and that at the meal on the eve of Yom Kippur he sang, shed exactly two tears, then blessed over stuffed fish intestines with 'fill all our wishes' and over the 'yikhil' soup with 'Let Israel hope in the Lord', returning to great joy.
